english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for both needing something and needing to do something.
Use 要 as the all-purpose spoken way to say that someone is required to do something.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is needed or that someone must do something.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for saying that someone must or needs to do something.
Use 要 when want means need, request, require, or be advised to do something.
Use 要 when the duty sounds firm or close to an instruction rather than neutral advice.

examples.english: I need to go to work today.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1

examples.english: You must remember to bring an umbrella, or you'll get soaked.
examples.traditional: 你要記得帶遮，唔係會濕晒。
examples.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 m4 hai6 wui5 sap1 saai3

examples.english: You require this form to be handed in today.
examples.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 gam1 jat6 gaau1 ni1 fan6 biu2

examples.english: I have to go to work tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1

examples.english: I want to take today off because I have something to do.
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ngo5 jau5 si6 jiu3 cing2 gaa3

examples.english: You ought to get to work on time tomorrow; don't be late again.
examples.traditional: 你聽日要準時返工，唔好再遲到。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zeon2 si4 faan1 gung1 m4 hou2 zoi3 ci4 dou3

english.note: Use 要 as the all-purpose choice when something requires a stated amount of money or costs someone money.

examples.english: The cost of this phone is three thousand dollars.
examples.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jiu3 saam1 cin1 man1

boxes.meaning: to want, to ask for something

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when asking for an item or service.
Use 要 when asking for an item or service, or when something is required or demanded, rather than when asking someone to perform an action.

examples.english: I’d like to request a cup of iced lemon tea.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4

examples.english: I want to ask for a glass of iced lemon tea.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4
